Settings.AdvancedNote:
Portable settings: data/settings.json
Recovery: data/recovery/<Project-ID>
Undo history: session only, latest 100 logical edits
Theme: Neutral Dark
Settings.AutosaveNote: Autosave creates recovery snapshots only. It never overwrites a .TDFE project. The latest 3 snapshots per project are retained; unchanged original image bytes are shared.
Settings.DiscardNote: Normal exit still asks Save / Don't Save / Cancel. Don't Save dismisses that session's recovery prompt.
Settings.InterfaceNote: Neutral Dark · Controller stays visible. Drag its right border to resize.
Settings.InvalidFields: Some settings were invalid; safe defaults were used.
Settings.PrecisionNote: Sampling source: Original Reference (fixed). Display precision never changes stored RGBA or internal HSB precision.
Settings.RestartLanguage: Language changes apply the next time you open TraceDeck FE. Save your project before restarting.
Settings.SafetyNote: No capture, injection, telemetry, continuous renderer, or persistent Undo history.
Settings.SessionNote: Recovery choices are shown before session restore. Forza is detected afresh; native handles are never saved.
Settings.ShortcutNote: Click a key field, then press a combination. Work shortcuts reserve keys only while Controller or Forza is foreground.
Settings.Title: TraceDeck FE · Settings
Settings.Unreadable: Settings could not be read; defaults were used. Projects were not changed.
Shortcut.Invalid: Choose a key with optional Ctrl, Alt, or Shift.
Shortcut.ModifierRequired: Work shortcuts require Ctrl or Alt.
Shortcut.PasteReserved: Ctrl+V is reserved for clipboard input.
Shortcut.Reserved: This system/game shortcut is reserved. Choose another combination.
Tip.AddPalette: Add the current color to your palette. Duplicates are allowed.
Tip.Cancel: Return to your current work without discarding it.
Tip.Center: Center the reference in the target client area.
Tip.CenterGuide: Show a center line of the target, independent of the image.
Tip.Contrast: Adjust display contrast after grayscale; the source stays unchanged.
Tip.CopyB: Copy normalized brightness at the configured precision.
Tip.CopyH: Copy normalized hue at the configured precision.
Tip.CopyHsb: Copy all three Forza HSB values.
Tip.CopyS: Copy normalized saturation at the configured precision.
Tip.DeletePalette: Remove this palette color. Undo can restore it.
Tip.DiscardRecovery: Dismiss this recovery. No manually saved project is deleted.
Tip.DontSave: Continue without these edits and dismiss this session's recovery.
Tip.Fit: Fit and center the reference within the target client area.
Tip.GeneratePalette: Append 2–12 original-source colors; keep existing palette items.
Tip.Grayscale: Preview in grayscale; the original color data stays intact.
Tip.Grid: Show a grid aligned to the target client area.
Tip.GuideOpacity: Adjust the opacity of grid and center guides.
Tip.Lock: Let clicks pass through to the target. Unlock to move or zoom the reference.
Tip.Magnifier: Show original pixels enlarged while picking a color.
Tip.New: Start a new project after checking unsaved changes.
Tip.Opacity: Adjust reference opacity without changing the controller.
Tip.OpenLastSave: Open the saved project and dismiss this older recovery snapshot.
Tip.OpenProject: Open a self-contained .TDFE project and its embedded reference.
Tip.OpenReference: Load a supported image; replacement may reset its transform.
Tip.PaletteName: Rename this color. Drag the swatch to reorder it.
Tip.PickColor: Pick one original-reference pixel, not the game or display effects. Esc cancels.
Tip.Position: Move the reference within the target window.
Tip.ResetAll: Reset position, transform, effects, opacity, visibility and guides. Keep the source and palette.
Tip.ResetEffects: Reset grayscale and contrast without altering the original.
Tip.ResetGuides: Turn off the grid and center guides and reset their settings.
Tip.ResetTransform: Reset scale, rotation and flips while keeping position.
Tip.Resize: Drag to resize the controller; each layout remembers its width.
Tip.RestoreRecovery: Restore these edits as unsaved work. Your saved .TDFE stays untouched.
Tip.RestoreShortcuts: Replace all custom shortcut mappings after confirmation.
Tip.Rotation: Rotate the reference around its center in 5° steps.
Tip.Save: Save the project with its original reference and editing state.
Tip.SaveAs: Save a .TDFE copy at a chosen location.
Tip.SelectWindow: Connect the overlay to a running window.
Tip.Settings: Adjust language, layout, input and recovery preferences.
Tip.Shortcut: Click and press a key combination. Reserved or duplicate keys are rejected.
Tip.Spacing: Set the distance between target grid lines.
Tip.Undo: Undo the last logical edit in this session.
Tip.Visible: Toggle whether the reference image is visible.
Tip.Zoom: Resize the reference while keeping its aspect ratio.
Ui.DropHelp: Drop an image or press Ctrl+V. TDFE embeds the Original Reference.
Ui.Footer: EVENT-DRIVEN · ORIGINAL SOURCE · IDLE WHEN UNCHANGED
Ui.PaletteHelp: Generated colors append; existing manual colors are never removed.
Ui.ResetHelp: Transform reset keeps position. Center or Fit changes position.
